Thanks everyone for the call this morning — quick recap and owners:  

Summary: walked through retention policy, export mechanics, and demo of anonymized export. NimbleCare's compliance team confirmed they got the SOC 2 questionnaire. Key clarifications we covered:  
- Retention windows: request/response metadata retained for 90 days by default; control-plane audit logs retained for 365 days. We will provide a one-pager with exact fields and retention per log type.
- Redaction: PII is redacted at ingestion by default; request/response bodies containing customer data are hashed and not stored in plain text in export artifacts.
- Export format: we demonstrated CSV and ndjson exports; fields included: timestamp, request_id, model_id, tokens_in, tokens_out, route, caller_org_id, redaction_flags.

Open items / owners:  
- Priyom: produce anonymized-export-sample.json and nimblecare_log_sample_listing.csv and upload to the Drive folder by EOD 9/22.
- Evelyn: finalize retention-summary-2026Q3.pdf and runbook snippets and share by 9/22 morning.
- Michael: add HubSpot note and share Drive link + access instructions to Jenna once artifacts are uploaded.

Attachments delivered after call: nimblecare_log_sample_listing.csv (sample index), logs_sample_list.csv (field map). Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2bNmbleCareAuditSamples

Thanks —
